newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Halter Marine detailed.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Halter Marine detailed.

text.p: -- Merrill Lynch analyst Janet Rasmussen confirmed she started Halter Marine with a near-term accumulate and a long-term buy.
-- She said she set an 18-month price objective of $17.50 to $18.50 on the stock and earnings estimates for March 1997 of $0.80 per share and for 1998 of $1.05.

-- The analyst said she was attracted by the company's strong position ahead of what she believes will a new building cycle for offshore supply vessels. It would be the first upturn in offshore vessel construction in more than a decade since the last boom resulted in severe overbuilding.
-- "The new build cycle will not occur for 18 months, but I think when it does occur they are the best positioned," she said.
-- Rasumussen said the offshore supply vessel business could amount to more than 25 percent of Halter's earnings over the long run.
-- The company is also well-positioned for long-term growth in the double-hull double tank barge business, which accounts for about 25 to 30 percent of its current businss.

-- She noted that the Oil Pollution Act of 1990 mandated that all vesssels working in U.S. waters have to be double- hulled by 2015. Halter has built more than three times as many double-hulled craft as any other domestic competitor, she said.
-- The company currently derives a little over half its revenues by building small craft for the U.S. Navy and other government agencies both in the United States and abroad, she said.
-- Halter Marine gained 5/8 to 14-5/8 early Wednesday.
